import pytest

def test_solve_poly_system_infinite_solutions():
    from sympy import symbols, Poly
    from sympy.solvers.polysys import solve_poly_system
    import pytest

    x, y = symbols('x y')

    # Case from issue: x - 1 = 0 (should raise)
    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError):
        solve_poly_system((x - 1,), x, y)

    # Case from issue: y - 1 = 0 (was incorrectly returning [(1,)])
    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError):
        solve_poly_system((y - 1,), x, y)

    # Additional cases from the submitted test diff (Poly form)
    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError):
        solve_poly_system(Poly(x - 1, x, y), (x, y))
    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError):
        solve_poly_system(Poly(y - 1, x, y), (x, y))
